name: Phoenix Firestorm AppImage
tagline: Advanced viewer for Second Life and OpenSimulator virtual worlds
description: The Phoenix Firestorm Viewer is the leading third-party viewer for Second Life and OpenSim grids. This community AppImage distribution by Lethja bundles the 64-bit Linux client with full AVX2 accelerated mesh rendering, spatial voice, Havok collision physics tools, and UI skin customizations.
features: AVX2 optimized graphical pipeline with high-framerate mesh rendering
Deep compatibility with Second Life and OpenSimulator independent grids
Advanced building, scripting, and photography camera tools
Customizable UI layouts, color themes, and radar tracking panels
